\section[(dialogue)]{Food and the home — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R61-first-pass-food-and-the-home}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for poor and clean.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a house, a room, a window, a chair, a table
  \item a wall, a bed, a cupboard, the ground; the earth, a mirror
  \item a lock, a plate, a knife, a fork, a spoon
  \item a bottle, a kitchen, a bathroom, a glass, a notebook
  \item a pencil, a pen, a school, a bag, money
  \item a map, a lesson, an answer, a word, a game
  \item a letter, a newspaper, a tree, a flower, a leaf
  \item a mountain, a forest, a river, a lake, a stone
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A house? (\textbf{\fa{خانه}}, \emph{khâne}.) A room? (\textbf{\fa{اتاق}}, \emph{otâgh}.) A window? (\textbf{\fa{پنجره}}, \emph{panjere}.) A chair? (\textbf{\fa{صندلی}}, \emph{sandali}.) A table? (\textbf{\fa{میز}}, \emph{miz}.) A wall? (\textbf{\fa{دیوار}}, \emph{divâr}.) A bed? (\textbf{\fa{تخت}}, \emph{takht}.) A cupboard? (\textbf{\fa{کمد}}, \emph{komod}.) The ground; the earth? (\textbf{\fa{زمین}}, \emph{zamin}.) A mirror? (\textbf{\fa{آینه}}, \emph{âyene}.) A lock? (\textbf{\fa{قفل}}, \emph{ghofl}.) A plate? (\textbf{\fa{بشقاب}}, \emph{boshghâb}.) A knife? (\textbf{\fa{چاقو}}, \emph{châghu}.) A fork? (\textbf{\fa{چنگال}}, \emph{chângâl}.) A spoon? (\textbf{\fa{قاشق}}, \emph{ghâshogh}.) A bottle? (\textbf{\fa{بطری}}, \emph{bottri}.) A kitchen? (\textbf{\fa{آشپزخانه}}, \emph{âshpazkhâne}.) A bathroom? (\textbf{\fa{حمام}}, \emph{hammâm}.) A glass? (\textbf{\fa{لیوان}}, \emph{livân}.) A notebook? (\textbf{\fa{دفتر}}, \emph{daftar}.) A pencil? (\textbf{\fa{مداد}}, \emph{medâd}.) A pen? (\textbf{\fa{خودکار}}, \emph{khodkâr}.) A school? (\textbf{\fa{مدرسه}}, \emph{madrese}.) A bag? (\textbf{\fa{کیف}}, \emph{kif}.) Money? (\textbf{\fa{پول}}, \emph{pul}.) A map? (\textbf{\fa{نقشه}}, \emph{naghshe}.) A lesson? (\textbf{\fa{درس}}, \emph{dars}.) An answer? (\textbf{\fa{جواب}}, \emph{javâb}.) A word? (\textbf{\fa{کلمه}}, \emph{kalame}.) A game? (\textbf{\fa{بازی}}, \emph{bâzi}.) A letter? (\textbf{\fa{نامه}}, \emph{nâme}.) A newspaper? (\textbf{\fa{روزنامه}}, \emph{ruznâme}.) A tree? (\textbf{\fa{درخت}}, \emph{derakht}.) A flower? (\textbf{\fa{گل}}, \emph{gol}.) A leaf? (\textbf{\fa{برگ}}, \emph{barg}.) A mountain? (\textbf{\fa{کوه}}, \emph{kuh}.) A forest? (\textbf{\fa{جنگل}}, \emph{jangal}.) A river? (\textbf{\fa{رودخانه}}, \emph{rudkhâne}.) A lake? (\textbf{\fa{دریاچه}}, \emph{daryâche}.) A stone? (\textbf{\fa{سنگ}}, \emph{sang}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{School, nature and animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R61-second-pass-school-nature-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for sand and a cloud.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item sand, a cloud, the sea, fire, snow
  \item soil, wind, a desert, a dog, a cat
  \item a horse, a cow, a goat, a sheep, a bird
  \item a mouse, a tiger, an elephant, a monkey, a snake
  \item a bear, a camel, a donkey, a butterfly, an ant
  \item a wolf, big, small, fresh, old
  \item long, short, warm, cold, slow
  \item fast, easy, hard, expensive, cheap
  \item full, empty, rich, poor, clean
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Sand? (\textbf{\fa{ماسه}}, \emph{mâse}.) A cloud? (\textbf{\fa{ابر}}, \emph{abr}.) The sea? (\textbf{\fa{دریا}}, \emph{daryâ}.) Fire? (\textbf{\fa{آتش}}, \emph{âtash}.) Snow? (\textbf{\fa{برف}}, \emph{barf}.) Soil? (\textbf{\fa{خاک}}, \emph{khâk}.) Wind? (\textbf{\fa{باد}}, \emph{bâd}.) A desert? (\textbf{\fa{بیابان}}, \emph{biyâbân}.) A dog? (\textbf{\fa{سگ}}, \emph{sag}.) A cat? (\textbf{\fa{گربه}}, \emph{gorbe}.) A horse? (\textbf{\fa{اسب}}, \emph{asb}.) A cow? (\textbf{\fa{گاو}}, \emph{gâv}.) A goat? (\textbf{\fa{بز}}, \emph{boz}.) A sheep? (\textbf{\fa{گوسفند}}, \emph{gusfand}.) A bird? (\textbf{\fa{پرنده}}, \emph{parande}.) A mouse? (\textbf{\fa{موش}}, \emph{mush}.) A tiger? (\textbf{\fa{ببر}}, \emph{bebar}.) An elephant? (\textbf{\fa{فیل}}, \emph{fil}.) A monkey? (\textbf{\fa{میمون}}, \emph{meymun}.) A snake? (\textbf{\fa{مار}}, \emph{mâr}.) A bear? (\textbf{\fa{خرس}}, \emph{khers}.) A camel? (\textbf{\fa{شتر}}, \emph{shotor}.) A donkey? (\textbf{\fa{خر}}, \emph{khar}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\fa{پروانه}}, \emph{parvâne}.) An ant? (\textbf{\fa{مورچه}}, \emph{murche}.) A wolf? (\textbf{\fa{گرگ}}, \emph{gorg}.) Big? (\textbf{\fa{بزرگ}}, \emph{bozorg}.) Small? (\textbf{\fa{کوچک}}, \emph{kuchek}.) Fresh? (\textbf{\fa{تازه}}, \emph{tâze}.) Old? (\textbf{\fa{قدیمی}}, \emph{ghadimi}.) Long? (\textbf{\fa{بلند}}, \emph{boland}.) Short? (\textbf{\fa{کوتاه}}, \emph{kutâh}.) Warm? (\textbf{\fa{گرم}}, \emph{garm}.) Cold? (\textbf{\fa{سرد}}, \emph{sard}.) Slow? (\textbf{\fa{آهسته}}, \emph{âheste}.) Fast? (\textbf{\fa{تند}}, \emph{tond}.) Easy? (\textbf{\fa{آسان}}, \emph{âsân}.) Hard? (\textbf{\fa{سخت}}, \emph{sakht}.) Expensive? (\textbf{\fa{گران}}, \emph{gerân}.) Cheap? (\textbf{\fa{ارزان}}, \emph{arzân}.) Full? (\textbf{\fa{پر}}, \emph{por}.) Empty? (\textbf{\fa{خالی}}, \emph{khâli}.) Rich? (\textbf{\fa{پولدار}}, \emph{puldâr}.) Poor? (\textbf{\fa{فقیر}}, \emph{faghir}.) Clean? (\textbf{\fa{تمیز}}, \emph{tamiz}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
